canonical_project: Quang Nam provincial integrated data center
owner: Quang Nam provincial authorities / Department of Information and Communications
notes: Bao Phap Luat reports the Quang Nam integrated data center (about 249 billion VND, including main DC, SOC and SD-WAN network) was inaugurated and put into use on 9 Oct 2023 at floor 6 of the provincial archive center, Tam Ky; part of the 2021-2025 e-government/digital-government project. No MW disclosed.
